scope: Actual CPU Classical LEM2; 600/1600/3200 total source rows and 4/6/8 first features
limitations: Not full PMLB data or 100+ sources, sample budgets are capped
Do not extrapolate runtime to 700 GB, GPU, 20+ features or hundreds of clients
Peak RSS is max process since start, and therefore monotonic within each process; not isolated incremental memory
No confidence interval on runtimes: one run per configuration
This is bounded G8 feasibility, not enterprise large-data scaling proof
